test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Kishori Amonkar is famous for which of the following forms of music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustani classical vocals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kishori Amonkar**

 
 
• Leading **Hindustani classical vocalist Kishori Amonkar (10 April 1932 – 3 April 2017) belonged to the Jaipur Gharana**, or a group of performers who share a certain musical aesthetic.
 
• She performed in the **light classical genres of thumri and bhajan as well as the classical genre of khyal**.
 
• Amonkar studied under her **mother Mogubai Kurdikar**, a classical singer from the Jaipur Gharana, **but throughout her career, she experimented with a range of vocal genres**.
 
• In **1987 and 2002**, respectively, Amonkar was given the **Padma Bhushan and the Padma Vibhushan**, two of India's highest civilian honours.
 
• She received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship in 2009 and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1985**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Young Amonkar started **taking vocal lessons in Hindustani classical music from Anjanibai Malpekar of the Bhendibazaar Gharana** in the early 1940s.
 
• She wrote about **musical theory and practice in the Marathi book Swaraartha Ramani**, which was published in **2010**.
 
• The documentary **Bhinna Shadja**, which was made by **Amol Palekar and Sandhya Gokhale, features Amonkar as its subject**.
 
• In **1991**, she also received the **esteemed Dr T. M. A. Pai Outstanding Konkani Award **and she was** one of the seven recipients of the M.S. Subbulakshmi Awards for classical music in 2016**.
